HOME SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

19. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
